[[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], [[King/Legends|King]] of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], lived in a '''hut''' in the [[Dulok Swamp]] with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Urgah]], and their [[Unidentified Dulok cub 1|three]] [[Unidentified Dulok cub 2|mischievous]] [[Unidentified Dulok cub 3|children]].
